g.text: Reduced example: resistance bit only; other growth effects and IL11 off.
m > 1: expected expansion; m < 1: expected decline.
M is NOT a transition-probability matrix; its row sums equal m.
Control states, mutation probabilities and offspring means
The finite execution controller is distinct from the population-state Markov kernel
Figure 2 | Q and M use row-parent / column-offspring ordering (S, R). Panel C gives conditional offspring means before mutation.
Natural death d excludes therapy; ON uses kS = 0.90, kR = 0.04. IL11 is off. Relapse is a trajectory classification, not a controller state.
